newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam border soldiers found dead after massacre.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam border soldiers found dead after massacre.

text.p: Police and military investigators have recovered the bodies of two border soldiers believed to have been responsible for a bloody shooting rampage last month in central Vietnam in which seven people were killed.
A military official in Thua Thien Hue province told Reuters on Thursday that farmers had found their bodies in a hut close to a rice field near the border with Laos earlier this week.
He said autopsies had showed the two men shot each other at point-blank range. They had been evading police and military search teams since the incident on July 29.
"All the results of the autopsies match with those of the killers," he said. "We can declare this case closed."

The two men shot a local tax collector's son and then killed his family after becoming involved in a row while drinking. They opened fire on others as they made their escape, killing a total of seven people including soldiers.
